_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. config.json is gitignored, so your laser IP and bed calibration survive a git pull. Every key is optional — anything you leave out keeps the shipped default. Flags (--laser/--port/--bind) and HELIX_* env vars override this file.

machine._comment: Merged over data/machine.json, so name only what differs. usable_* is the far edge the head was confirmed to reach; safety_mm is the no-go border the server refuses to cross. Verify with a frame test before widening either.
machine.name: Epilog Helix 24x18 (30W)
